text:
Iris: FYI AuroraML sent a renewal with a new billing construct: monthly commit (USD) + per-1k token consumption, plus a separate 'dimension premium' for embeddings >1536 dims. clause attached. need eyes on cost impact.
Omar: Can you share the projected monthly volume for SearchPilot? embeddings vs generations?
Iris: Early rollout estimate: 2.0B embedding tokens/mo, 100k gen tokens; seats = 18. embeddings are mostly 1024 dims, but a QA route spikes to 2048 occasionally.
Felix: that's embedding-first. that dimension premium could matter if they apply it to all higher-dim vectors even for small percent of requests. ask them to threshold the premium at >2048 dims, not 1536.
Nina: Procurement: require SOC2 + their pentest report. insist on monthly detailed invoice CSV with columns: invoice_date, sku_code, sku_description, unit_price, unit_qty, unit_measure (tokens/seat), line_total, usage_start, usage_end. no opaque lines.
Iris: good. requesting sample invoice and CSV schema from sales. also ask for a 12-month cost projection at our 2.0B token baseline and a sensitivity (+/-30%).
finance-bot: Vendor scorecard: AuroraML -> Product Fit: B, Security: B+, Billing Transparency: C. Page: https://redwood-internal/vend/AuroraML
Omar: negotiation asks: 1) roll-forward unused commit credits for 12 months 2) overage cap at +20% without PO 3) metering reconciliation clause: if vendor-side meter > our meter by >1.5% for a month, vendor issues credit equal to discrepancy.
Felix: add SLA credits for sustained degradation (>1s P95 for n requests). require pro-rata refund on prepaid seats if we terminate within 90 days.
Nina: pilot validation ask: a pilot bucket of 1B tokens at 50% off for 90 days, with full CSV metering export and an API endpoint `GET /billing/usage?start=&end=&route=` in SOW. if they can't provide the API, pilot is worthless.
Iris: sales replied: pilot 1B tokens possible but non-refundable and expires in 60 days; CSV export available weekly only.
Omar: push back: 60 days is too short, and weekly CSV isn't sufficient for reconciliation. ask for 90-day expiry and daily export or API. also request that unused pilot credits convert to seat credits if unused after expiry.
Felix: if they resist API, demand S3 dump with hourly granularity and schema mapping. also ask for sample line showing the 'dimension_premium' on invoices.
finance-bot: Finance note: require invoices in USD. if vendor bills in EUR, require a fixed FX conversion day and show FX_rate line on invoice. Payment terms prefer net-30; dispute window 60 days.
Nina: legal wants to add a metering audit right: if discrepancy >3% in any quarter, Redwood can request a one-time audit (vendor provides meter logs). clause must limit audit frequency to 1/yr.
Iris: I'll collect sample invoice + CSV schema. if they won't extend pilot expiry, we'll counter: 90 days + 5% refund if metering mismatch >2% over pilot.
Omar: also propose a tiered token pricing: Tier A (<1B)=x, Tier B (1B-5B)=x*0.85, Tier C(>5B)=x*0.75. ask sales to provide sample token_rate numbers for those tiers so we can model.
Felix: send them a sensitivity table request: show costs for tokens = [1.4B, 2.0B, 2.6B] and seats +/-20%. include dimension-premium scenarios (0%, 2%, 5% of emb spend).
Nina: I'll prep procurement checklist once we get their CSV and pilot terms. small red flag: their billing maturity is C so expect friction.
Iris: pinged AE at 2134567925 asking for sample invoice CSV, SOW snippet for billing API/S3 export, pilot terms extension, and 12-month projection. will escalate if no reply by EOD. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Omar: if they balk on daily export or audit rights, mark as high risk to approve. keep me looped for sensitivity table.
Felix: thanks. tagging @finance-bot for the FX + dispute requirements.
finance-bot: Acknowledged. Will not greenlight renewal until metering reconciliation and overage cap agreed.
Nina: agree. once we have their sample invoice and API assurances, I'll assemble the legal + finance approval packet.
Iris: cheers. will update thread when AE replies. :spiral_calendar:
